question: A triangle has sides of length 13 cm, 14 cm and 15 cm. Find the area of the triangle.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

For 13, 14, 15 triangle ⇒ known Heron result

Area = 84

Direct standard triangle

No need full calculation

**∴ Answer = 84 cm²**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Sides of triangle = 13 cm, 14 cm, 15 cm

**Formula used:**

Heron’s formula: Area = √[s(s−a)(s−b)(s−c)]

 
 14 15 13 

Triangle with given sides

Use Heron’s formula

**Calculation:**

⇒ s = (13 + 14 + 15) ÷ 2 = 21

⇒ Area = √[21 × (21−13) × (21−14) × (21−15)]

⇒ = √[21 × 8 × 7 × 6]

⇒ = √7056

⇒ = 84

**∴ The correct answer is 84 cm².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Heron’s Formula

Area = √[s(s−a)(s−b)(s−c)]

Semi-perimeter

s = (a + b + c)/2

Special Triangle

13-14-15 triangle has area 84
